title: Matter Export Verifier
description: Fully offline, upload-driven verifier for a Helm matter export (matter-manifest.schema.json, HELM-MATTER-BUILD-SPEC.md §2). Validates the manifest's shape, recomputes manifest_digest via the same JCS canon path OCG artifacts use, and renders every binding and deadline with a distinct, never-collapsed status label. Optionally checks one bound artifact's own execution_hash, eddsa-jcs-2022 signature, and RFC 6962 anchor against a binding's subject_hash. Zero network calls anywhere in the tool.

bound_artifact.description: OPTIONAL: one OCG artifact referenced by a binding, to check against its subject_hash

verification_report.description: verdict, schema/digest check rows, per-binding status labels, per-deadline open/done status

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_matter_export
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recomputes a Helm matter manifest's manifest_digest, validates its shape, and reports each binding/deadline with a distinct status. Optionally checks a supplied bound artifact against a binding's subject_hash.
